record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Neginah<WH05058>, <FI>A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> my cry<WH07440>, O God<WH0430>; attend<WH07181><WTH8685> unto my prayer<WH08605>.

From the end<WH07097> of the earth<WH0776> will I cry<WH07121><WTH8799> unto thee, when my heart<WH03820> is overwhelmed<WH05848><WTH8800>: lead<WH05148><WTH8686> me to the rock<WH06697> <FI>that<Fi> is higher<WH07311><WTH8799> than I.
For thou hast been a shelter<WH04268> for me, <FI>and<Fi> a strong<WH05797> tower<WH04026> from<WH06440> the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>.

I will abide<WH01481><WTH8799> in thy tabernacle<WH0168> for ever<WH05769>: I will trust<WH02620><WTH8799> in the covert<WH05643> of thy wings<WH03671>. Selah<WH05542>. <RF>trust: or, make my refuge<Rf><CM>
For thou, O God<WH0430>, hast heard<WH08085><WTH8804> my vows<WH05088>: thou hast given<WH05414><WTH8804> <FI>me<Fi> the heritage<WH03425> of those that fear<WH03373> thy name<WH08034>.

Thou wilt prolong<WH03254><WTH8686> the king's<WH04428> life<WH03117><WH03117>: <FI>and<Fi> his years<WH08141> as many<WH01755> generations<WH01755>. <RF>Thou...: Heb. Thou shalt add days to the days of the king<Rf> <RF>as...: Heb. as generation and generation<Rf>
He shall abide<WH03427><WTH8799> before<WH06440> God<WH0430> for ever<WH05769>: O prepare<WH04487><WTH8761> mercy<WH02617> and truth<WH0571>, <FI>which<Fi> may preserve<WH05341><WTH8799> him.
So will I sing<WH02167><WTH8762> praise unto thy name<WH08034> for ever<WH05703>, that I may daily<WH03117><WH03117> perform<WH07999><WTH8763> my vows<WH05088>.<CM>
